{size: 24}{color: #FFFF00}{outline: #FF0000, 2}= What Is Burst Mode? ={size}{color}{outline}

{color:#FFFF00}Burst Mode{color} is a battle mode where you aim to
reach new high scores by defeating enemies
under the {color:#FFFF00}Burst Mode conditions{color} you select, 
such as conditions that strengthen the enemies
and restrictions to the challenging team!

{size:24}{color:#FFFF00}{outline:#FF0000,2}= Rewards ={size}{outline}{color}

Collection{color}" after you meet the unlocking conditions of

even more enjoyable!

please check "{underline:begin}{linkToNews:100811}Help{linkToNews}{underline}".

a phase, some of the selected Burst Mode conditions will not
be activated within the phase after defeating a certain enemy. 

* Please note that the accounts of any users found conducting
improper behavior may be suspended without prior notice due to
having violated the Terms of Service. Once an account has been
suspended, the user will no longer be able to log in and play.
Please check the Terms of Service and enjoy the game while
following the rules. 

* Please note that the event content and dates are
subject to change without prior warning.

* You can attempt the event under normal mode
by not selecting any Burst Mode conditions.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing 
Dragon Ball Z Dokkan Battle!

Dear Players,

Thank you for the continuous support for 
Dragon Ball Z Dokkan Battle!

Please be informed that the administration team of 
Dragon Ball Z Dokkan Battle has the right to suspend 
the account of any user found violating the Terms of Service.

=== Example Violations === 

- Tampering with in-game data 
- Tampering with the calculation of Tournament Points 
- The use of external tools and/or illegal software 
- Any use of other practices that violate laws or the 
Terms of Use.

=== Handling of Accounts That Violate the Terms of Service ===

The administration team has the right to suspend the
accounts of users who violate the Terms of Service.

Once an account is suspended due to violation, the owner 
will not be able to log in and play anymore. Please enjoy 
Dragon Ball Z Dokkan Battle while following the rules.

=== Notice Regarding Account Transfer === 

If an account is found in violation of the Terms of Service, 
it will be suspended even if the owner at the time obtained 
the account from an account transfer made by other players. 
The suspension cannot be lifted. For this reason, please do 
not receive or give accounts from or to other players.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing 
Dragon Ball Z Dokkan Battle!

bodies.description:
The lineups for the exclusive Dokkan Festival and
the exclusive Legendary Summon Carnival, where you
can perform summons with {color:#FFFF00}Summon Point Tickets{color},
have been updated on {date:1785301200,D,L}!

{color:#FFFF00}Summon Points{color} can be obtained by performing
Multi-Summons with {color:#FFFF00}Dragon Stones{color}!

Collect {color:#FFFF00}Summon Points{color} and exchange them for
{color:#FFFF00}Summon Point Tickets{color} that allow you to recruit 
characters who have appeared in Summon Events 
such as Dokkan Festivals, Legendary Summons 
and Legendary Summon Carnivals!

{size:24}{color:#FFFF00}{outline:#FF0000,2}= How to Obtain Summon Points ={size}{outline}{color}

{color:#FFFF00}Summon Points{color} can be obtained by performing
a {color:#FFFF00}Multi-Summon with Dragon Stones{color} in certain
Summon Events ({color:#FFFF00}up to the 3rd Multi-Summon{color}).

{color:#FF9900}- Related Summon Events{color}
Summon Events that feature new characters, 
such as {color:#FFFF00}Dokkan Festivals{color}, {color:#FFFF00}Legendary Summons{color} 
and {color:#FFFF00}Legendary Summon Carnivals{color}.

The amount of obtainable Summon Points differs 
between Summon Events. Please check the 
announcements of the Summon Events for more 
information.

When Multi-Summon discounts are available,
during which the text "Only XX:XX:XX" is displayed,
{color:#FFFF00}Summon Points{color} can be obtained at the following timings.

1.
{color:#FFFF00}The first 3 Multi-Summons performed with
Dragon Stones during the period in which
the text "Only XX:XX:XX" is displayed.{color}

2.
{color:#FFFF00}The first 3 Multi-Summons performed with
Dragon Stones after the discount period ends.{color}

Please note that Summon Points cannot be obtained
starting from the 4th Multi-Summon performed in the
above periods nor by performing a free Multi-Summon.

{size:24}{color:#FFFF00}{outline:#FF0000,2}= How to Use Summon Points ={size}{outline}{color}

{color:#FFFF00}300 Summon Points{color} can be exchanged for a 
"{color:#FFFF00}Summon Point Ticket (Dokkan Festival){color}" or 
a "{color:#FFFF00}Summon Point Ticket (Carnival){color}" at the 
"Treasure" section of Baba's Shop. The tickets
can be used to perform summons in the
corresponding Summon Events.

{color:#FF9900}- Summon Events where Summon Point Tickets can be used{color}
- {color:#FFFF00}Dokkan Festival [Summon Point Ticket]{color}
- {color:#FFFF00}Legendary Summon Carnival [Summon Point Ticket]{color}

* Please check the announcements "{underline:begin}{linkToNews: 107116}Dokkan Festival
[Summon Point Ticket]!{linkToNews}{underline}" and "{underline:begin}{linkToNews: 107117}Legendary Summon
Carnival [Summon Point Ticket]!{linkToNews}{underline}" for more information
on the available characters. 

* Please navigate the following path to check the Summon
Points you have: "Team" --> "Items" --> "Treasure".

* Summon Events with new lineups will be available regularly.

* Please note that the amount of obtainable Summon Points
and event content are subject to change without prior notice.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing
Dragon Ball Z Dokkan Battle!

bodies.description:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your support of Dragon Ball Z Dokkan Battle.

Due to changes to the verification mechanisms of Google
Play and the App Store, some players were unable to log in
{duration:1749535200,1749804780,D2,L}.

In response to this situation, we have temporarily adjusted
the verification process, which is scheduled to be restored
at a later date.

If your device falls under any of the following conditions, 
you may not be able to log in to the game and will receive
messages such as "User authentication failed" or "An
unknown error has occurred".

{color:#FF9900}- Google Play (Android) users{color}
{color:#FFBB66}1. Devices that downloaded the app outside Google Play{color}
Please proceed with data linking and then go to Google Play
to reinstall the game.

{color:#FFBB66}2. Devices that are not signed in to Google Play{color}
Please sign in to Google Play again.

{color:#FFBB66}3. Devices that are outdated or not supported by Google{color}
Please play the game with a device supported by Google.

{color:#FF9900}- App Store (iOS) users{color}
{color:#FFBB66}1. Devices with an older iOS version{color}
Some issues may be caused by the operating system version.
We recommend updating to iOS 15 or later.

{color:#FFBB66}2. Network connection or device time settings{color}
Please make sure your network connection is stable and that
"Set Automatically" is turned on in the "Date & Time" settings.

We apologize for the inconvenience caused. Please refer to
the above instructions to check the status of your device
and the app as soon as possible.

Due to this login issue, the following actions will be taken.

{color:#FF9900}- Applicable players{color}
Players whose devices fall under any of the above conditions
and were unable to log in to the game after the maintenance
on {date:1749535200,D,L} until {date:1749804780,DT,L}.

{color:#FF9900}- Actions{color}
- {color:#FFFF00}1 Dragon Stone{color} will be distributed.
- Any consecutive login record that was interrupted during
the period in which the issue occurred will be automatically
continued.

by this issue.

{color:#FF9900}- Claim Period{color}
Distributed sequentially starting from {date:1752044400,D,L}.

* The Dragon Stone will be sent directly to your Gift Box.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

Dragon Ball Z Dokkan Battle.

announcement.title: Important Notice for Belgian Players

bodies.description:
Dear Players,

Earlier this year, the Belgian Gaming Commission
issued a report stating that certain forms of 
"loot boxes" will be considered as a form of gambling. 
While we do not share the views of the Belgian Gaming 
Commission on this point, we have decided to take steps 
to comply with their interpretation of Belgian gambling
laws.

Starting today, players in Belgium are no longer entitled, 
and will be unable, to purchase "Dragon Stones", 
"Summon Tickets", or any item pack that contains those items. 
Belgian players will still however be able to use the 
"Summon" feature using "Dragon Stone" that is earned through 
gameplay or that is given out as part of in-game events.

We understand that this will have an impact on the enjoyment
of our players in Belgium, but we feel that we have no choice
but to make these changes so that our fans can continue to
play Dragon Ball Z Dokkan Battle. 

We apologize for the inconvenience. If there is any change in 
the situation or an update to the Belgian Gaming Commission's 
interpretation, we will let you know.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing Dragon Ball Z 
Dokkan Battle.
